newsitem.title: UK: Rugby sees benefits from RBP restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Rugby sees benefits from RBP restructuring.

text.p: Rugby Group Plc said on Friday that it expects to yield benefits in excess of $15 million per annum from the second half of 1998 after a restructuring its distribution business in the U.S., Rugby Building Products (RBP).

The British building materials firm said in a statement that the reorganisation will be fully covered by a restructuring charge of 9.9 million stg it took in its 1996 results to account for a general restructuring of the group's activities.
It also said the purchase of Boulton and Paul and integration with John Carr is well underway and will lead to significant cost benefits in the second half of this year.
The company also noted that results at its subsidiary Pioneer Plastics, which was split from RBP earlier this year, are ahead of the same period last year.
